title: Bank Account
statement:
Build a `BankAccount` class that keeps a balance, starting at 0. Its `deposit(amount)` method adds money. Its `withdraw(amount)` method takes money out only when the balance covers it: it reports whether the withdrawal went through, and a refused withdrawal leaves the balance unchanged, so the balance never drops below 0.

The first line of input is the number of commands `n`. Each of the next `n` lines is `deposit X` or `withdraw X`, where `X` is a whole number of 0 or more. Run the commands on one account in order. After each command, print the new balance on its own line, or print `insufficient funds` when a withdrawal is refused. Taking out exactly the whole balance is allowed and leaves 0.

Input:

```text
4
deposit 100
withdraw 30
withdraw 80
deposit 5
```

Expected output:

```text
100
70
insufficient funds
75
```
hints: Keep the balance on the object, so every method works on the same number.
Check the balance before you change it. If the amount is bigger, stop and report the refusal.
Withdrawing exactly the balance is fine. Only an amount larger than the balance is refused.
